If you were mid-task, read docs/handoffs/README.md (this repo continuity index) or run /pickup to resume. Note: MEMORY.md is your PERSONAL cross-project index, not this repo task-state."}}'

R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -f "$R/hooks/scan.js" ] || R="${PLUGIN_ROOT}"; if [ -f "$R/hooks/scan.js" ]; then node "$R/hooks/scan.js"; else echo '{"systemMessage":"keystone: scan.js not found under the plugin root (plugin updated mid-session?) - the injection scanner is INACTIVE; restart this session to restore keystone hooks."}'; fi

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff format "$f";; *.js|*.ts|*.jsx|*.tsx|*.json|*.css|*.scss|*.html|*.md|*.yaml|*.yml) if [ -x node_modules/.bin/prettier ]; then node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f"; elif command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then prettier --write "$f"; fi;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
